text: POC, the Swedish helmet and apparel maker, is in the portfolio of Investcorp, the Bahrain-based alternative investment firm, which acquired POC in 2015 and still lists it as a portfolio company.
short: POC is owned by Investcorp (acquired 2015, still in its portfolio).

source.name: Investcorp portfolio: POC
source.quote: Established in 2005 in Stockholm, Sweden, POC is a leading manufacturer of premium skiing and cycling helmets, apparel, and accessories.
source.note: Investcorp's own portfolio section lists POC with the tag 'Acquired' (page shows 'Stockholm, Sweden', the acquisition block, and links poc.com), meaning POC remains in its portfolio in 2026.

additionalSources.name: Pedal Magazine: Investcorp Acquires POC
additionalSources.quote: POC, a leading manufacturer of skiing and cycling helmets, apparel and accessories, has today been bought by Investcorp.
